trial_name: SARA real-world blind proof warm start
objective: Evaluate external traditional AI behavior under controlled variable changes while SARA captures lessons.

runs.label: baseline
runs.prompt_template: Propose a structured approach to prove CartiGene claim X with direct assumptions listed.

runs.label: temperature_shift
runs.prompt_template: Same proof target as baseline; provide alternate derivation path and identify uncertain steps.
runs.variable_shift: raise temperature +0.15 for all non-baseline agents

runs.label: constraint_shift
runs.prompt_template: Give proof attempt with strict scientific method phases: observe, hypothesize, predict, test, refine.

runs.label: epoche_shift
runs.prompt_template: Repeat proof attempt with epoche constraint: no assumptions, only direct statements and derivable steps.

runs.label: stress_shift
runs.prompt_template: Final comparative run: summarize strongest and weakest claims in previous runs and output corrected proof skeleton.
runs.variable_shift: restore defaults, compare against all prior outputs
